definition: The finite release inventory explicitly enumerated as CR-001 through CR-016 in RULEBOOK.md and SR-001 through SR-009 in SUPERSEDED_RULES.md.
claim_boundary: This universe closes the compiled release inventory only. It is not an exhaustive extraction of every normative proposition in all pre-cutoff messages or Git blobs.
excluded_from_count: UNRESOLVED_CANDIDATES.md contains provenance and admission issues rather than workflow-rule candidates.
SRC-001 and SRC-004 are evidence corpora and are not claimed to have been exhaustively mined by this release.
Post-cutoff Codex proposals require a separate candidate universe and user disposition.
